use default

use POSITION = (x: int, y: int)

is_prime(number: int) -> bool =>
    number > 1 /\ ((2..number)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= number)
        |> all(divisor => number % divisor != 0))

spiral() -> Pipe[POSITION] is
    let x mut = 0
    let y mut = 0
    let run mut = 1

    yield (x = x, y = y)

    do
        for step in 0..run do
            x = x + 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        for step in 0..run do
            y = y - 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        run = run + 1

        for step in 0..run do
            x = x - 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        for step in 0..run do
            y = y + 1

            yield (x = x, y = y)
        od

        run = run + 1
    od
si

let size = 21
let centre = size / 2

let grid = (0..size)
    |> map(row => (0..size) |> map(column => " ") |> collect_list())
    |> collect_list()

for placed in spiral() |> index() |> take(size * size) do
    if is_prime(placed.index + 1) then
        grid[centre + placed.value.y][centre + placed.value.x] = "*"
    fi
od

grid |> each((row: LIST[string]) => write_line(row |> join("")))
